test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who led the Brahmo Samaj immediately after Raja Ram Mohan Roy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devendra Nath Tagore.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Debendranath Tagore**__

 __
 
• Maharishi Debendranath Tagore was a **social reformer** and scholar. In **1842,** he became a member of the Brahmo Samaj, which Raja Rammohan Roy had established in 1828.
 
• Prior to that, he served as the** leader of the 1839-founded Tattvabodhini Sabha.**
 
• He was born in** Calcutta in May 1817.**
 
• Along with Raja Rammohan Roy, his father, Dwarkanath Tagore, was a very successful merchant and philanthropist in Calcutta.
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore, a well-known Bengali poet, artist, writer, and essayist, was his son.**
 
• The monthly theological newspaper Tattvabodhini Patrika was launched by the Debendranath Tagore-founded** Tattvabodhini Sabha.**
 
• **Both Tattvabodhini Sabha and Tattvabodhini Patrika **promoted the theories of Raja Rammohan Roy and concentrated on the methodical study of India's past with a reasonable viewpoint.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **Tatwabodhini Pathshala or Theological School** was established by Debendranath in **1844 to teach Vedanta** and prepare young men to instruct in the Brahmo religion.
 
• Soon after **Keshab Chandra Sen **joined the Samaj in 1858, he appointed him the acharya.
 
• **Keshab Chandra Sen and his adherents established the Brahmo Samaj of India in 1866 **following his removal as acharya in 1865.
 
• Debendranath Tagore's Samaj later became known as the Adi Brahmo Samaj.
 
• He wrote and published the theistic treatise of religion and ethics known as the **Brahma Dharma Grantha.**
